summary: Serious filmmaker's workstation that accidentally became a visual universe — professional production studio x underground media company x late-night editing suite x street photography x futuristic broadcast interface. Not cyberpunk-neon-everything; real and tactile, not generic AI futurism.

color_system.formula: 70% black/white cinematic imagery, 15% RGB/neon accent, 10% technical camera/broadcast graphics, 5% glitch/VHS/distortion texture

accent_palette.rule: one aggressive RGB accent dominates at a time; color should feel like it is breaking through the monochrome, never filling the design

options.name: electric-cyan
options.use: primary accent — links, tags, glow, focus states

options.name: electric-magenta
options.use: alternate accent for variation / secondary campaigns

saturation_levels.rule: never blend the two — accent stays crisp and isolated against desaturated ground

color_system.contrast_ratio: high — near-black ground against pure white type, minimum AA compliance, accent color reserved for elements that must pop instantly
application_patterns: accent color appears on max 1–3 elements per screen
accent used for interactive/technical elements (tags, timecodes, playheads, focus rings) not large fills
photography stays desaturated or true black & white; color is layered on top via UI, not baked into the image

primary_display.example_family: Unbounded / Archivo Black / similar geometric-industrial display
primary_display.usage: hero titles, oversized headlines, section numerals

technical_label.usage: timecodes, coordinates, recording info, technical captions, tags

case_and_spacing.labels: uppercase, wide letter-spacing (+0.1em to +0.18em), small size

typography.text_color_pattern: white text on black by default; accent color reserved for links, tags, and technical labels
effects: occasional oversized type partially cropped off-frame
rare chromatic-aberration duplicate text (red/cyan offset) for glitch emphasis — sparing use only
typography.readability_note: high contrast keeps grain/scanline texture from compromising legibility; never place body text directly over unfiltered imagery without a scrim

composition_and_layout.element_placement: asymmetric, editorial; content anchored to frame edges like a viewfinder rather than centered by default
composition_and_layout.rule_of_thirds: used for photographic subject placement; UI elements (labels, timecodes) sit at frame corners echoing camera HUD conventions
composition_and_layout.symmetry: primarily asymmetric with occasional symmetric moments for emphasis (e.g. centered hero title within an otherwise off-center frame)
composition_and_layout.white_space: generous negative space around subjects; avoid crowding — space itself signals confidence
composition_and_layout.focal_point_strategy: one clear subject per frame; everything else recedes into black or desaturated ground
composition_and_layout.layering: base image/black ground → grain/noise → scanline or texture pass → technical UI overlay (corner labels, crosshairs, timecode) → sparing accent glow

visual_elements.icon_style: outlined, thin-stroke, technical/UI-referential (not filled, not skeuomorphic)

image_treatment.filters: desaturated to true black & white as default; grain and noise added, never sterile/clean
image_treatment.borders: thin white hairline frames or black letterbox bars on cinematic (16:9) crops

visual_elements.texture_usage: grain and noise are load-bearing — they are what keeps the brand feeling tactile/real rather than synthetic
visual_elements.branding_placement: monogram/wordmark stays small and technical (like a camera watermark), never oversized or centered as a logo lockup

shadow_usage.depth: deep, hard-edged shadows rather than soft ambient shadows
shadow_usage.direction: single dominant light source implied, directional not diffuse
shadow_usage.intensity: strong — shadows should read as absence of light, not a soft dropshadow effect

contrast_and_depth.highlight_technique: hard highlights, occasional blown-out/overexposed accents for a gritty digital-camera feel; rim/edge lighting on subjects
contrast_and_depth.dimensionality: mostly flat UI with photographic depth doing the dimensional work; avoid glossy 3D UI chrome
contrast_and_depth.depth_layering: black ground establishes infinite depth; grain sits just above it; UI elements float on top at a consistent flat plane

style_characteristics.industry_alignment: independent music/media production, videography, photography, live production
style_characteristics.target_audience: independent musicians, content creators, small brands who want their media to feel shot by a real operator, not a template

technical_specifications.export_notes: preserve grain — do not run through denoising or heavy JPEG compression that flattens texture; keep blacks true black, not crushed-gray

example_use_cases: Portfolio site hero: full-bleed desaturated night photo, white uppercase condensed title, single cyan accent on the CTA button, mono timecode label in a corner
Instagram post: black & white production still, thin white border frame, small monospace caption with fake coordinates/timecode, one cyan or magenta accent element
Video lower-third: monospace label on a black bar, thin white rule line, no gradient fill
Merch/promo graphic: bold condensed uppercase wordmark cropped at the frame edge, grain texture over black, single accent color used only on one word or icon
